name: sushiai-workspace
description: A macOS workspace for terminal agents, powered by Herdr

scripts.format: prettier --write src electron scripts tests *.json *.ts *.html README.md
scripts.package:dmg: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test:contracts: node --test tests/app-ipc.test.cjs tests/navigation.test.cjs tests/extension-manifest.test.cjs tests/extension-registry.test.cjs tests/extension-routes.test.cjs tests/extension-contract-coverage.test.cjs tests/extension-records.test.cjs
scripts.test:extensions: node --test tests/extension-manager.test.cjs tests/extension-manifest.test.cjs tests/extension-registry.test.cjs tests/local-extensions.test.cjs tests/surface-state.test.cjs
scripts.test:core: node --test tests/layout.test.cjs tests/navigation.test.cjs tests/workspace-actions.test.cjs tests/chat-threads.test.cjs tests/dialog-state.test.cjs tests/app-boundary.test.cjs tests/workspace-state.test.cjs tests/herdr-snapshot.test.cjs tests/inspection-worker.test.cjs tests/git-history.test.cjs
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:conventions && npm run lint && prettier --check src electron scripts tests *.json *.ts *.html README.md && git diff --check

author: sushi-killer
